1.20.1.1.10.0:
Stability, compatibility and correctness release.

Fixes the crash when ISS-Scroll Descriptions or ISS-Restrictions inspect a Botany spell: the Botany school's display name had no colour, and Iron's Spells' SchoolType#getTargetingColor() dereferences that colour without a null check.

Rebuilds mana routing as a single per-cast transaction. A failed, cancelled or interrupted cast can no longer drain mana or consume catalysts, same-tick casts can no longer share payment state, and Botania payment now works for a player carrying a single mana item (it previously never could).

Every upgrade orb now applies its own attribute and returns its own item; rune-enhanced scrolls finally do something; Botany power, resistance and mana-efficiency attributes are attached to players and actually read.

BACK UP YOUR WORLD BEFORE UPGRADING. See docs/UPGRADING-1.10.0.md.
